source='''def transform(grid):
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)})
    scores = {}
    for color in colors:
        above = sum(v == color for row in grid[:split] for v in row)
        below = sum(v == color for row in grid[split + 1:] for v in row)
        scores[color] = below - above
    chosen = max(colors, key=lambda c: scores[c])
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
'''
